headline: Per-share earnings hold steady, slightly below last year
summary_short: EPS was CNY 0.35, flat versus the prior quarter and down 2.8% from CNY 0.36 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It was unchanged q/q and slipped 2.8% y/y. A company operating update in the web results shows cumulative January-September commercial coal output down 8.1% y/y, but no Q3 financial statements were found. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
